notes.title: Let's celebrate, Shamans!
notes.content:
Today is the 6-month anniversary of the release of Star Shaman!

We're incredibly proud to have built a game shared and enjoyed by thousands of people in the world! And there's a ton more things to say about it - from launching our soundtrack to attending Raindance to following our first Speedrun contest. All of this fantastic journey thanks to our players!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078264/dc261d4a8f1cfcdc3bfc82dc4e529d20117dc629.jpg

When you have such a great community, you want to give back: we're releasing today our latest update, featuring many additions that make the game longer, smoother, more enjoyable - in a word, better. 
We hope you enjoy it as much as we do.

DIFFICULTY LEVELS
The game now features 3 difficulty levels, which you select when starting a NEW GAME: 
- EASY replenishes your health gauge after each planet you revive, 
- MEDIUM gives you only 3 hearts back, 
- HARD gives you only 1 heart back (in EASY mode, Events that used to provide Health will now give you BioSeqs).

REWORKED ENEMY BATCHES
The new enemy scaling and batches provide a smoother difficulty curve between solar systems. It is now possible - for seasoned players - to start the game fresh in either CLASSIC or BOSS CHECKPOINT MODE and finish it in a single run.

BETTER SPELL ACCESSIBILITY
Spellcasting gestures have been reworked so they are less wide and high, accommodating shorter or younger players.

SPEEDRUN TIMER
You can now time your run with a specific chronometer displayed in the bottom left corner of your HUD. You can activate it in the options menu BEFORE you start or continue a run. This is especially useful for Let's Play or Contests with video capture.

AND MUCH MORE:
- You are now able to skip the tutorial when you start a NEW GAME.
- Player progression is now fully displayed when you die, so you know what's coming ahead to help you in your journey.
- Weapon damages and ammunition have been revisited, providing a better variety of use.
- The START button now correctly displays START when you launch the game for the first time.

notes.title: Wasabi Super Nova update
notes.content:
Reporting live from Lunar Groves

After a successful December update, we got straight to work on more of the features OUR PLAYERS have been asking for. Today, our newest update has arrived and it will introduce Shamans old and new to a more welcoming galaxy.

WINDOWS MR HEADSET SUPPORT
First, let's welcome new Shamans: Windows Mixed Reality headsets are now supported!

BOSS CHECKPOINT MODE
In this game mode, your progression will be saved once you defeat a Boss - no more starting the game over when you die in solar system 2 or 3! We’ve kept a classic mode for Shamans who revel in the original challenge of the game.
 
BALANCING ADJUSTMENTS
Shamans, we heard you loud and clear about the difficulty of our solar systems. You will now see that the combat is a bit easier, and shorter. Also, every time you regenerate a planet, your health is now refilled, so you can breathe a little more after a challenging level.

A NEW OFFENSIVE SPELL
You can unlock a new spell, the Carom. It’s a rippling shot which damages your target and the enemies nearby, like a ricochet. That's now 9 spells available throughout your journey!]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078264/9c4bd6cf34ac5853c987c47aea54e79945f3c924.png

ACHIEVEMENTS
11 original achievements help you track your progress in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078264/41b26a178590820f4f36f29fdfac5a7cef3e05d5.png

GRAPHIC REFRESH
We have added 14 new moons and you will be delighted to see the skies have been improved.

UPDATED LIV APP
We’ve updated Liv to version 1.5 for our Shamans to record even funkier moves!

[hr][/hr]

All these additions will give you more time for multiple runs to explore new combos, play styles and everything our galaxy has to offer.

Hurry Shaman! Adventure awaits!
Don’t forget; the Universe is counting on you.

notes.title: Major Update to Star Shaman
notes.content:
Greetings Shaman

Here at Lunar Grove we have been circling the galaxy in preparation for your next voyage. We are incredibly grateful for all the initial feedback we received on the game. Please don’t stop sharing. We love hearing from you. 

Today, Star Shaman 2.0 is released and with it comes some big changes.

Generally, you will see a stronger sense of character progression. Weapons and perks now unlock in the Reliquary during the game instead of when you die. In addition, each time you die, perks and persistent spells will be added to your Shaman Sphere for your next run, giving you more strength for your return.

We know it can be discouraging when you respawn but respawning now grants you get more Bio-Seqs. And more Bio-Seqs means you can buy more things in the shop at the beginning of each run.

You have proven your strength and intelligence. In this update, we believe you are ready for 3 new spells.
•	Beam: Hold trigger to channel it towards enemies.
•	Nova: Stun/Fry hand-thrown grenade.
•	Jolt Daemon: A jolt-firing entity to fight alongside you for a limited time.

As you enter the war against the Architects of Entropy, you will notice a reworked HUD (Heads-Up-Display) where it is easier to check your hit points and current score.

Be on the lookout for 15 new moons. Just when you thought you had the map memorized, we remind you the galaxy is enormous, and your planet-hopping has just begun!

The tutorial has been entirely reworked thanks to your feedback. You will see it is shorter and more fluid to move through. It also emphasizes the use of both hands as using the shield is key to your success. You will notice how parrying an incoming projectile now translates into an additional charge on your attack wand!

Your space traveling has sped up! The tunnels are shorter from planet to planet making your time traveling through space more dynamic. We know every second counts in the fight to save life. 

You will hear that every character has its own distinct voice, and our favorite mentor Heidi is now speaking English when the astral teleporter allows it. 

Finally, fellow Shamans speaking Spanish, Italian, Japanese or Chinese can join in on the fun. These Shamans will join the English, French, and German-speaking Shaman on their quest. That’s 7 languages supported.

Now go, Shaman.
The Universe is counting on you!

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Star Shaman!

We have made significant progress with the Astral Teleporter and have addressed the drops in performance. The entire experience runs more smoothly and evenly across the board.

The Kybele have been shoring up their reliquary and it should now be easier to understand what Shamans can trade there. We held numerous talks over the last days and we have now convinced them to dismiss their annoying habit of sticking item cards into your hands after leaving the reliquary.

We also have added general quality of life improvements.

The Astral Teleporter technology is key to our success and we are working round the clock to provide you and your fellow Shamans with future updates. Stay tuned because we will be in contact again soon.

Bend a beam!
